prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for an elaborate hand-cut PAPER pop-up terrarium representing Pokémon Emerald's lush Safari Zone. Landscape 1536x1024. TWELVE COMPLETE, clearly separated objects in four columns and three rows; transparent gaps and margins. Front-view theatre flats, visibly FLAT colored cardstock, thin pale paper edges, drawn leaf veins and bark marks, overlapping individual cut-paper leaf clusters with small cast shadows, lovingly crafted rich botanical detail. Strong fresh jade, emerald, lime and warm ochre reeds. NOT realistic foliage, NOT miniature 3D trees, NOT voxel, NOT photographs. No ball shell, backdrop, labels or characters.
Row 1: (1) an irregular tall broad-leaved rainforest tree with branching FLAT brown paper trunk, individually layered toothed leaves, a few curling vines, complete canopy; (2) a different smaller wide umbrella tree with airy separated leaf bunches and visible branch gaps, crooked trunk; (3) a weathered wooden observation platform with short roof, open empty cabin, thin railing, four stilts and simple side ladder, all made of thin folded paper strips, transparent between the stilts, unobstructed isolated silhouette; (4) a distant wide irregular ridge of several flat teal treetop silhouettes with a few fern cutouts, layered forest foliage, no ground rectangle.
Row 2: (1) hanging leafy branch with several distinct dangling vines and ochre seed pods, complete curved silhouette; (2) two separate cream paper clouds, one broad and one small, no blue backing; (3) a narrow shallow wetland pool edged by two low paper reed clusters and a few white folded lily flowers, flat layered turquoise WATER strips clearly visible; (4) a short broken timber fence with creeping leaves and a small cluster of cattails, all separate paper cutouts, no scene backdrop.
Row 3: (1) a richly detailed fan of flat pointed grass blades with three small cream daisies and a curling fern shoot; (2) a completely different low bush of wide serrated leaves, little red berries and one folded yellow leaf; (3) a flat mossy log with two ivory mushrooms, light bark linework and thin protruding fern leaves; (4) two separately spaced ochre reed clumps, one tall with cattails and one short with seed heads, plus TWO small separate green leaf cutouts and one separate tiny folded orange paper butterfly to animate.
Every object fits entirely within its cell, no overlapping other cells. Keep generous clear margins, include authentic thin paper fibers, assembly tabs only at the base of standing props. Must read as many physical paper layers, not realistic objects cut out of a photo. Preserve true alpha transparency.
alpha: Original RGBA copied unchanged; cards selected by UV geometry.
